Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Madhuri Bhandari. I am a 44-year-old textile trader living in Hyderabad. Rajesh Tiwari has filed a police complaint against me over ₹15,10,000, and the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08148423302 or email madhuri.bhandari12@example.in.
